landing.heroTitle: The package registry your team controls
landing.heroSubtitle: Publish private Dart and Flutter packages, mirror pub.dev, and manage access for your whole organization — from one self-hosted binary.
landing.featurePrivateBody: Publish internal Dart and Flutter packages with the standard dart pub tooling — no forks, no workarounds.
landing.featureProxyBody: Read-through caching keeps builds fast and reproducible; full mirror mode covers air-gapped and regional setups.
landing.featureOrgsBody: Scoped CLI tokens, role-based access, and per-organization registry URLs keep publishing and consumption under control.
landing.featureSelfHostBody: Start with one binary, SQLite, and filesystem storage; switch to PostgreSQL, S3, and Redis when you scale.
landing.footerLicense: Open source under the MIT License
